findings.summary: Navigator-based language fallback detection is dead code -- unconditionally unreachable because the preceding block always writes to localStorage, making the subsequent localStorage read always truthy
findings.failure_scenario: N/A (dead code, not a runtime bug): the first block (lines 63-69) always executes localStorage.setItem for either zh-Hans or en-US on both branches; the localStorage.getItem on line 72 always retrieves that value; the if (lang) branch on line 73 always executes; the else branch (navigator detection) on lines 77-89 never runs. If someone modifies the first block without understanding this dependency, the navigator fallback could silently stop working
